title: Foundation: typed violations and deterministic rule results
objective: Represent rule outcomes, subjects, evidence, severity, and diagnostics independently from rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Violations contain structured data and stable identities, not preformatted prose.
Equivalent results compare and iterate deterministically.
Pass, fail, skipped, and incomplete-analysis states cannot be conflated.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
